title: Export records to CSV
body: Writes the report out for the nightly job.

files.patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,20 @@
 import csv
 import logging
 
 log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 
+def export(records, path):
+    handle = open(path, "w")
+    writer = csv.writer(handle)
+    for record in records:
+        writer.writerow([record.id, record.name])
+    return path
+
+
+def export_all(batches, path):
+    try:
+        for batch in batches:
+            export(batch, path)
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+
+
 def describe():
     return "csv exporter"
